traits.name: Minion
traits.description: The spear infantry's attacks can't critically hit, and they're immediately defeated when they suffer an injury.

traits.name: Martial Drill
traits.description: At the start of each scene, if the spear infantry has their shield and isn't Surprised, they gain the benefits of the Brace action until the start of their first turn.

traits.name: Military Tactics
traits.description: Once per round, the spear infantry can spend 1 additional focus to use the Aid or Reactive Strike reaction without using their reaction.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: The spear infantry makes an Athletics test against the target's Physical defense, knocking them Prone on a success.

strikes.name: Shortspear
strikes.on-hit: if the target is Prone, they take an extra 4 (1d8) keen damage.
strikes.description: Attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) keen damage. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) keen damage, and if the target is Prone, they take an extra 4 (1d8) keen damage.

strikes.name: Shortbow
strikes.description: Attack +3, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) keen damage.
